title: biophytum albiflorum
intro: Biophytum albiflorum, commonly known as Sarsaparilla vine, is a plant species belonging to the Oxalidaceae family. It is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its numerous health benefits, including treating fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Biophytum albiflorum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. These bioactive compounds have been shown to possess antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects, contributing to the plant's therapeutic properties.
